title: All public school teachers to get laptops by 2028 — Marcos

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Friday reiterated his commitment to provide every public school teacher with a laptop by 2028. Speaking during the turnover of laptops under the Department of Education’s (DepEd) Computerization Program in Iloilo City, Marcos said teachers should be equipped with the tools they need to perform their duties effectively.
